mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates indicate tight monetary conditions, which may lead to decreased borrowing and spending, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are positive more than 50% of the time when FEDFUNDS is high, this hypothesis is invalidated.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 5% signals labor market weakness, which may lead to economic downturn and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns remain positive despite unemployment rising above 5%, this hypothesis is invalidated.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth slows while employment increases, it indicates conflicting economic signals, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate decreases while PAYEMS increases
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are positive despite conflicting signals, this hypothesis is invalidated.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing retail sales during a late-cycle expansion may signal an upcoming economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns remain positive despite slowing retail sales, this hypothesis is invalidated.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates strong supply chains, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative more than 50% of the time when INDPRO is rising, this hypothesis is invalidated.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in consumer price index above 3% may lead to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns remain positive despite CPI exceeding 3%, this hypothesis is invalidated.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth coupled with high unemployment indicates economic imbalance, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate is high while UNRATE is above 4.5%
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are positive despite conflicting economic signals, this hypothesis is invalidated.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid payroll growth during early-cycle recovery may indicate strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative despite strong payroll growth, this hypothesis is invalidated.
